mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and can cause elevated liver enzymes and hepatitis, with additive hepatotoxic potential; pyrazinamide also inhibits renal tubular secretion which may affect nitrofurantoin clearance.
action: Monitor liver function tests (ALT, AST, bilirubin) at baseline and during concurrent therapy; consider alternative antibiotics if hepatic impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for signs of hepatotoxicity.
